namespace Eleph\SQLite\Manifest;

use Eleph\SQLite\Sql\{Column, EdgePlacement, Index, TableSchema};
use Eleph\Runtime\Storage\RelationKind;

return new StorageManifest(
    tables: [
        'Inventory' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_inventory',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'created_at' => new Column('created_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'updated_at' => new Column('updated_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'name' => new Column('name', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'date_added' => new Column('date_added', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'date_expiry' => new Column('date_expiry', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
                'item_id' => new Column('item_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'location_id' => new Column('location_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_inventory_post_id_uniq' => new Index('clog_inventory_post_id_uniq', ['post_id'], true),
                'clog_inventory_item_id_idx' => new Index('clog_inventory_item_id_idx', ['item_id'], false),
                'clog_inventory_location_id_idx' => new Index('clog_inventory_location_id_idx', ['location_id'], false),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Item' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_item',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'created_at' => new Column('created_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'updated_at' => new Column('updated_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'name' => new Column('name', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'barcode' => new Column('barcode', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
                'default_expiry_unit' => new Column('default_expiry_unit', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
                'default_expiry_value' => new Column('default_expiry_value', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_item_post_id_uniq' => new Index('clog_item_post_id_uniq', ['post_id'], true),
                'clog_item_name_idx' => new Index('clog_item_name_idx', ['name'], false),
                'clog_item_barcode_uniq' => new Index('clog_item_barcode_uniq', ['barcode'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Location' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_location',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'created_at' => new Column('created_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'updated_at' => new Column('updated_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'name' => new Column('name', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_location_post_id_uniq' => new Index('clog_location_post_id_uniq', ['post_id'], true),
                'clog_location_name_uniq' => new Index('clog_location_name_uniq', ['name'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Site' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_site',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'name' => new Column('name', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_site_name_uniq' => new Index('clog_site_name_uniq', ['name'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'User' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_user',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'created_at' => new Column('created_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'updated_at' => new Column('updated_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'bio' => new Column('bio', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_user_post_id_uniq' => new Index('clog_user_post_id_uniq', ['post_id'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
    ],
    placements: [
        'Inventory.item' => new EdgePlacement('Inventory', 'item', 'Item', RelationKind::ManyToOne, 'clog_inventory', 'item_id', null, 'clog_item'),
        'Inventory.location' => new EdgePlacement('Inventory', 'location', 'Location', RelationKind::ManyToOne, 'clog_inventory', 'location_id', null, 'clog_location'),
        'Inventory.site' => new EdgePlacement('Inventory', 'site', 'Site', RelationKind::ManyToMany, 'clog_inventory_site', 'inventory_id', 'site_id', 'clog_site'),
        'Location.sites' => new EdgePlacement('Location', 'sites', 'Site', RelationKind::ManyToMany, 'clog_location_sites', 'location_id', 'site_id', 'clog_site'),
    ],
    columns: [
        'Inventory' => ['createdAt' => 'created_at', 'updatedAt' => 'updated_at', 'postId' => 'post_id', 'name' => 'name', 'dateAdded' => 'date_added', 'dateExpiry' => 'date_expiry'],
        'Item' => ['createdAt' => 'created_at', 'updatedAt' => 'updated_at', 'postId' => 'post_id', 'name' => 'name', 'barcode' => 'barcode', 'defaultExpiryUnit' => 'default_expiry_unit', 'defaultExpiryValue' => 'default_expiry_value'],
        'Location' => ['createdAt' => 'created_at', 'updatedAt' => 'updated_at', 'postId' => 'post_id', 'name' => 'name'],
        'Site' => ['name' => 'name'],
        'User' => ['createdAt' => 'created_at', 'updatedAt' => 'updated_at', 'postId' => 'post_id', 'bio' => 'bio'],
    ],
    joinTables: [
        'clog_inventory_site' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_inventory_site',
            [
                'inventory_id' => new Column('inventory_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
                'site_id' => new Column('site_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_inventory_site_pair_uniq' => new Index('clog_inventory_site_pair_uniq', ['inventory_id', 'site_id'], true),
                'clog_inventory_site_site_id_idx' => new Index('clog_inventory_site_site_id_idx', ['site_id'], false),
            ],
            '',
        ),
        'clog_location_sites' => new TableSchema(
            'clog_location_sites',
            [
                'location_id' => new Column('location_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
                'site_id' => new Column('site_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'clog_location_sites_pair_uniq' => new Index('clog_location_sites_pair_uniq', ['location_id', 'site_id'], true),
                'clog_location_sites_site_id_idx' => new Index('clog_location_sites_site_id_idx', ['site_id'], false),
            ],
            '',
        ),
    ],
);
